name: pf-fix-specs-arcane
about: fix-specs-arcane against the built packages classes, specs instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). The Arcane (Sorcerer) and Aerotheurge (Wizard) fixes of 2026-10-25 (bot fix_specs_arcane): Blink is 112 px (90 before) with a vanish, a bead trail and an arrival effect, Far Step rare 151; Blink crosses a line of ledge rails the dash cannot (the Shot raycast, not the vanilla Teleport's Any ray); the Thunder Orb moves 2.0 px a tick (about 60 px/s, +25%) on a 3 px body (6 before) with a bigger look and logs its speed; Living Mana is one pool shown as one blue bar in place of the health and mana bars for the local player (hwp specs arcane: living 1 bar on), the wizard keeps the vanilla bars.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:specs\] thunder orb: speed 2\.00 px/tick, ttl \d+ ms
\[HWP:specs\] living mana bar: on, health and mana bars hidden

allow: Resource name hash conflict in package 'mods/(HWP-[a-z0-9]+|HammerwatchPlus-All)\.bin' for file
